title: Article 162 Article 162  (1) A person that possesses the property of another for 20 years peacefully and openly with the intention to own it acquires ownership thereof.
statute_text:
Article 162 Article 162  (1) A person that possesses the property of another for 20 years peacefully and openly with the intention to own it acquires ownership thereof.
(2) A person that possesses the property of another for 10 years peacefully and openly with an intention to own it acquires ownership thereof if the person was acting in good faith and was not negligent at the time when the possession started.
(Acquisitive Prescription of Property Rights Other Than Ownership)
